title: Barriers Burned Away
author: Edward Payson Roe
description: "Barriers Burned Away" by Edward Payson Roe is a novel written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story explores themes of struggle, faith, and redemption against the backdrop of personal and societal challenges, centering around protagonists Dennis Fleet and his family as they grapple with hardships and seek to overcome the barriers life has thrown in their path.
